What's included

Surf, breakfast, surf again. Head out with your group for a morning surf. Back at the lodge, a big, healthy breakfast is waiting.

  • 7 nights' accommodation
  • 7 breakfasts
  • 5 dinners
  • 5 guided surf sessions of 2 hoursLevel 3: 5 coached surf sessions of 2 hours
  • 5 surf theory lessons
  • Unlimited surf equipment all week
  • Walk or ride to the surf, depending on the spot
  • A cultural or nature excursion
  • Unlimited drinking water
  • Unlimited local coffee and tea

Not included: airport pickup. From $220 pp, add it on the booking page.

The lodge

Footwear is discouraged. Chilling out is inescapable.

Footwear is discouraged. Chilling out is inescapable.

The lodge

There are just twelve rooms. That keeps a stay here personal, part of one big happy family.

When you're not on the water, lie out on a sunbed by the pool under the palms, hang out in the common area, take an ice-cold drink from the bar, or eat Sri Lankan produce from the lodge kitchen.

Outdoor swimming pool | Yoga chalet | Yoga, meditation and sound healing sessions | Ice baths | Lookout terrace, ocean view | Restaurant, breakfast, lunch and dinner, daily | Bar | Gluten-free and vegan options | Co-working space, high-speed internet, coffee and fresh juices | Free WiFi | Airport shuttle | Free private parking on site | Garden | Sun terrace

Our rooms

Mixed dorm room – 4 beds

Four single beds. The bathroom is outdoors, and it's yours.

Our new gallery room sleeps four in comfortable single beds and has its own outdoor bathroom. It suits larger groups, and travellers on a budget.

Sleeps 4 | 4 single beds | Private outdoor bathroom | Shared

Shared Twin Room – 2 Beds

Two beds and a private bathroom, with the beach in view all day.

The twin rooms look out on the beach all day, and each has a lovely private bathroom. There are two beds; the room is shared unless you choose private use on the booking page.

Deluxe double room

A queen-size bed for two and a private bathroom of its own.

Our double rooms have one queen-size bed and a private bathroom. To keep it just for the two of you, choose private use when you check out on the booking page.

Getting here

Henewatta Addara Gederawata, Ahangama 80650, Sri Lanka

Booking.com puts Kathaluwa West Beach 40 m from the lodge and Kabalana Beach 350 m. Kathaluwa station is 400 m away, Ahangama Beach 4 km and Koggala Airport 3.9 km.
